root_cause.text: The rtl8xxxu driver failed to initialize `hw->sta_data_size`, causing mac80211 to allocate insufficient memory for per-station driver private data (`struct rtl8xxxu_sta_info`), which lead to a slab-out-of-bounds write when `rtl8xxxu_sta_add()` accessed `sta->drv_priv`.
root_cause.evidence: The patch explicitly sets `hw->sta_data_size = sizeof(struct rtl8xxxu_sta_info);` in the probe function. The commit message and CVE description confirm that the missing initialization caused KASAN to report a slab-out-of-bounds write in `rtl8xxxu_sta_add()`.

vuln_statements.explanation: The driver sets hw->vif_data_size for interface private data but fails to initialize hw->sta_data_size for station private data. This omission causes mac80211 to allocate insufficient memory for struct rtl8xxxu_sta_info, leading to a slab-out-of-bounds write in rtl8xxxu_sta_add() when accessing sta->drv_priv.
